ruleset.name: mock-derms-dispatch-api
ruleset.description: quickstart.xml, with ClassNamingConventions taught about Maven Failsafe's *IT / *ITCase suffix. Reason: PMD's built-in testClassPattern only recognizes JUnit-style *Test(s)/TestCase names — it doesn't know this project's integration tests are *IT by Failsafe convention. This is a confirmed upstream gap (pmd/pmd#5919), not a misconfiguration on our side.
